<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
$up   = wp_upload_dir();
$file = $up['path'] . '/white-t-shirt.jpg';
file_put_contents( $file, base64_decode( '' ) );
$att = wp_insert_attachment( array( 'post_mime_type' => 'image/jpeg', 'post_title' => 'White t-shirt', 'post_status' => 'inherit' ), $file );
wp_update_attachment_metadata( $att, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $att, $file ) );
$p = new WC_Product_Simple();
$p->set_name( 'Custom T-shirt' );
$p->set_status( 'publish' );
$p->set_regular_price( '25' );
$p->set_image_id( $att );
$p->update_meta_data( '_lecouzpd_enabled', 'yes' );
$p->update_meta_data( '_lecouzpd_required', 'yes' );
$p->update_meta_data( '_lecouzpd_config', wp_json_encode( array(
	'image_id' => $att,
	'areas'    => array(
		array( 'id' => 'front', 'name' => 'Front', 'x' => 0.33, 'y' => 0.43, 'w' => 0.34, 'h' => 0.32, 'w_mm' => 280 ),
		array( 'id' => 'chest', 'name' => 'Chest logo', 'x' => 0.56, 'y' => 0.30, 'w' => 0.10, 'h' => 0.10, 'w_mm' => 90 ),
	),
) ) );
$id = $p->save();
update_option( 'blogname', 'Demo Shop' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_store_pages_only', 'no' );
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/%postname%/' );
activate_plugin( 'lecouz-product-designer/lecouz-product-designer.php' );
echo 'product ' . $id;
